name: BVZ Holding AG
summary: BVZ Holding AG, through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of public transport and tourism services in Switzerland. The company offers transport on the Matterhorn Gotthard Railway between Disentis and Göschenen and Zermatt; TäschZermatt train shuttle; car transport at the Furka Pass; freight transport between Visp and Zermatt; and Gornergrat Bahn and Glacier Express tourist offerings. It is also involved in rental of investment properties. BVZ Holding AG was founded in 1891 and is based in Brig, Switzerland.
